digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Rebar has no aggregation layer to query agent-driven dev loop trends over time despite maintaining rich event-sourced history
Agent-lifecycle signals (env/integration-diagnosis time, bug provenance, bug classification) leave no durable trace in the event store and cannot be derived structurally
Code-health metrics (coverage/complexity/clone) are computed ephemerally in CI and never persisted for historical analysis
A passive instrumentation layer must close tier-C blindspots via minimal emissions from trustworthy code (gate handlers, git blame) rather than agent self-report
The `rebar metrics` command must surface all available metrics across three lenses (agent loop health, codebase decay, gate value) with date-range filtering and structured unavailable states
